title: Writing --- With A Clock
label: ch:ge-mit-der-uhr
canDo: I can complete the Start Deutsch 1 writing paper's two parts inside its published twenty minutes, filling all five fields and keeping the text near thirty words.

payoff.summary: Complete GE-W03-mit-der-uhr: six minutes for the five fields and fourteen for the thirty-word text, then count the words and check the capitals last.
payoff.note: Timing, part count, field count and word length are read out of german/task-shapes/a1.json, which transcribes the Goethe materials, not invented for the lesson.
